verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI and an MCP server, and its machine-payments docs support stablecoin payments over x402. Together these imply the crypto features can be scripted and driven programmatically without a UI. However, nothing in the pack shows headless or CI use of the crypto features specifically, and some flows are interactive (customer wallet linking in the Express Dashboard, hosted or embedded onramp checkout). Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI documentation for crypto/stablecoin APIs, CLI coverage of crypto resources, test-mode/CI automation examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.
